大日本帝國統計年鑑 1940

215 tables · 152,548 cells · LLM-transcribed · JSON · Excel ☰ Contents

大日本帝國統計年鑑 1940

Dai Nippon Teikoku tōkei nenkan (Statistical Yearbook of the Empire of Japan), 第五十九回 (No. 59), 昭和十五年 (Shōwa 15), published 1941
內閣統計局, 東京, 1941

All 209 numbered tables are transcribed, with four unnumbered sub-tables printed beside them and the weights-and-measures tables (度量衡比較、合數及略算法); the contents, the index, the page of charts (which print no figures), the bureau's list of publications and the colophon are not. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one, and long tables read in sections by different readers are joined; where a table is printed as successive column blocks with different year ranges (table 25), each block is a separate part. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted (many differ by one or two units of rounding in thousand-yen figures). Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. About 320 of some 119,000 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?]; a literal ? printed in the book is kept as ?. A spot check, in which a second model re-transcribed two tables (1,296 figures) independently, agreed on all but one cell, which is marked unreadable.
